_comment: Single source of truth for the release versions of every Insimul package. Each package manifest MUST match its entry here — the native engine packages are checked by `npm run engines:manifests`, the four web packages under `web` by the release preflight (`npm run release:dry-run`). Packages are independently releasable, so versions may diverge — but a package's manifest and its VERSIONS.json entry may never disagree. When bumping a version, edit it here first, then sync the manifest (+ VERSION/plugin files for the native engines), then update that package's CHANGELOG.md. See docs/PUBLISHING.md (web) and docs/RELEASING.md (native).
